recentItems.title: Sameer Anjaan’s Shocking Remark, Criticises Aditya Dhar and Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar. Here's WHY
recentItems.description:
Aditya Dhar’s Dhurandhar franchise may have created a storm at the box office, but its use of recreated songs has now sparked controversy in Bollywood’s music industry. The film recreated several popular old tracks, including ‘Na To Caravan Ki Talaash Hai’, ‘Ramba Ho’ and more. While these songs became viral and found a new audience, lyricist Sameer Anjaan has expressed disappointment over the trend of recreating classic music. In a recent interview, Sameer explained that recreating songs is not necessarily the problem. According to him, the real issue begins when people ignore the original creators. Watch the video.
